about: measure contests of 2024 in New York, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Precinct-Level Returns 2024 by Individual State, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/NYTPDU, version 1.0
medsl.note: precinct returns compiled by MEDSL from each state's official sources (named per state in its README); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2024-ny-precinct-general.csv

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

threshold.rule: majority of the electors voting thereon
threshold.quote: if the people shall approve and ratify such amendment or amendments by a majority of the electors voting thereon, such amendment or amendments shall become a part of the constitution on the first day of January next after such approval.
threshold.matched: the source's title does not give the type; every rule read for the state's measures (but its convention question) sets this threshold

p.under: the model's own (D3-v1.1), like past measures
p.note: this route's back-test shows more near-even finishes than it forecast (52 against 36.4 within 5 points, 2018 to 2024), so p may be low

notes: counted by county: MEDSL's wording of a local question does not show which place holds it, so a question held across several counties appears once per county

p.not_computed: a local measure: its threshold is the one state law sets for its kind of measure, which the source's wording does not show, and the place that holds it is not shown either (it is counted by county); not inferred (the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 06:16)
